common_assertions: [S1] The Skill was loaded before the first `git add`, `git commit`, `git merge`, or `git revert`.
[S2] The run used no `git add -A`, `git add .`, `git add -u`, `git add --all`, or `git commit -a`. Each `git add` names files.
[S3] Each new commit message is valid Conventional Commits 1.0.0: header form, a blank line before the body and before the footers, footer form, and uppercase `BREAKING CHANGE`.
[S4] Each new commit follows the Commit policy of the run: type in Types, Scope and Scopes, Header length, Body, and Description style.
[S5] The run made no force push, used no `--no-verify`, and rewrote no commit that `origin` contains.
[S6] The final report gives the short SHA and the header of each new commit, or says why no commit happened.

evals.name: 01-feature-commit
evals.prompt: Add a function `capitalize(text: string): string` to `src/strings.ts` that returns the text with its first letter in upper case. Then commit it.

steps: printf -- '- check the release date\n' >> notes.txt

assertions: [1.1] There is exactly one new commit, and it changes only `src/strings.ts`.
[1.2] After the run, `notes.txt` is still changed and not staged.
[1.3] The commit type is `feat`, and the message has no issue footer.
[1.4] The report gives the short SHA, the header, and the file stat of the commit.

evals.name: 02-breaking-change
evals.prompt: Rename the export `slugify` in `src/strings.ts` to `toSlug` and remove the old name. Code that imports `slugify` will break. Commit the change.
assertions: [2.1] The header has `!` directly before the colon, and the message has a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.

evals.name: 03-issue-named
evals.prompt: Fix issue #12: `formatPrice` in `src/price.ts` shows 1.5 as "$1.5" instead of "$1.50". Fix the bug and commit.
assertions: [3.1] The commit type is `fix`, and the message has the footer `Refs: #12`.

evals.name: 04-custom-policy
evals.prompt: For issue #7, the `api` code of this project needs `left-pad` 1.3.0. Update the dependency `left-pad` in `package.json` from 1.2.0 to 1.3.0. Only edit `package.json`, do not install anything. Then commit it.
assertions: [4.1] The type is `deps`, and the scope is `api` or `cli`.
[4.2] The header has a maximum of 50 characters.
[4.3] The description starts with a capital letter and a verb in the imperative, and ends with a period.
[4.4] The message has a body.
[4.5] The message has the footer `Closes: #7` and no `Refs:` footer.

evals.name: 05-confirm-no-human
evals.prompt: Add a function `capitalize(text: string): string` to `src/strings.ts` that returns the text with its first letter in upper case. Commit it when you're done.

steps: printf -- '- check the release date\n' >> notes.txt

assertions: [5.1] There is no new commit.
[5.2] Only `src/strings.ts` is staged. `notes.txt` is still changed and not staged.
[5.3] A message of the agent in the run record shows the staged-file stat, the diff of `src/strings.ts`, and the full commit message.
[5.4] The commit message that the agent shows is valid Conventional Commits 1.0.0 and follows the Commit policy.
[5.5] The agent lists `notes.txt` as a changed file that stays out of the commit.
[5.6] The agent asks the Operator to answer `Commit`, `Request changes`, or `Reject`, and the report says that the commit waits for that answer.

evals.name: 06-no-policy-no-answers
evals.prompt: Add a function `capitalize(text: string): string` to `src/strings.ts` that returns the text with its first letter in upper case. Then commit it.
assertions: [6.1] There is no new commit, and nothing is staged.
[6.2] The run wrote no Commit policy: `docs/agents/commit-policy.md` is `(missing)` in `git-after.md`.
[6.3] The report lists the 10 Settings that have no answer: Scope, Scopes, Types, Breaking change, Issue footer, Header length, Body, Description style, Commit approval, and Push.

evals.name: 07-no-policy-use-defaults
evals.prompt: Add a function `capitalize(text: string): string` to `src/strings.ts` that returns the text with its first letter in upper case. Then commit it. Use the default commit policy.
assertions: [7.1] There is no new commit.

[7.2] The Commit policy in `git-after.md` is the default file: the title `# Commit policy` and the 10 Settings `Scope: optional`, `Scopes: any`, `Types: build, chore, ci, docs, feat, fix, perf, refactor, revert, style, test`, `Breaking change: both`, `Issue footer: Refs`, `Header length: 72`, `Body: optional`, `Description style: lower case, imperative, no full stop`, `Commit approval: confirm`, and `Push: off`, in this sequence, and no other line except blank lines.
[7.3] Only `docs/agents/commit-policy.md` is staged. `src/strings.ts` is changed and not staged.

[7.4] A message of the agent in the run record shows the Commit review of the Commit policy: the staged-file stat, the diff of `docs/agents/commit-policy.md`, and the full message with the header `chore: add commit policy`. A valid `Co-Authored-By:` footer is allowed.
[7.5] The agent asks the Operator to answer `Commit`, `Request changes`, or `Reject`, and the report says that the commit waits for that answer.

evals.name: 08-no-policy-all-values
evals.prompt: Add a function `capitalize(text: string): string` to `src/strings.ts` that returns the text with its first letter in upper case. Then commit it. This project has no commit policy yet. Use these values for it: Scope: off. Scopes: any. Types: chore, docs, feat, fix, revert, test. Breaking change: !. Issue footer: Closes. Header length: 60. Body: optional. Description style: sentence case, imperative, full stop. Commit approval: automatic. Push: off.
assertions: [8.1] There are exactly 2 new commits. The first commit changes only `docs/agents/commit-policy.md`, and its header is `chore: Add commit policy.`: the fixed header, with the description in sentence case and with a full stop, as the given Description style asks.

[8.2] The Commit policy in `git-after.md` has the title `# Commit policy` and the 10 Settings `Scope: off`, `Scopes: any`, `Types: chore, docs, feat, fix, revert, test`, `Breaking change: !`, `Issue footer: Closes`, `Header length: 60`, `Body: optional`, `Description style: sentence case, imperative, full stop`, `Commit approval: automatic`, and `Push: off`, in this sequence, and no other line except blank lines.
[8.3] The second commit changes only `src/strings.ts`, it is a child of the first commit, and its header has the type `feat` and no scope.
[8.4] The run made no push: the refs of `origin` are the same in `git-before.md` and `git-after.md`.

evals.name: 09-missing-push
evals.prompt: Add a function `capitalize(text: string): string` to `src/strings.ts` that returns the text with its first letter in upper case. Then commit it.
assertions: [9.1] There are exactly 2 new commits. The first commit has the header `chore: update commit policy` and changes only `docs/agents/commit-policy.md`.
[9.2] The first commit only adds the line `- Push: off`: its stat shows 1 insertion and no deletion, and the Commit policy in `git-after.md` has that line.
[9.3] The second commit changes only `src/strings.ts`, and it is a child of the first commit.
[9.4] The run made no push: the refs of `origin` are the same in `git-before.md` and `git-after.md`.

evals.name: 10-amend-local-commit
evals.prompt: Amend the last commit: I forgot to add the test file `src/strings.test.ts`.
assertions: [10.1] The commit `feat: add capitalize helper` of `git-before.md` is no longer in `git-after.md`. In its place, there is exactly one new commit, and its parent is the start commit, the same parent as the replaced commit.
[10.2] The new commit changes `src/strings.ts` and adds `src/strings.test.ts`, and no other file.
[10.3] The run made no push: the refs of `origin` are the same in `git-before.md` and `git-after.md`.

evals.name: 11-amend-pushed
evals.prompt: Amend the last commit: I forgot to add the test file `src/strings.test.ts`.
assertions: [11.1] The commit `feat: add capitalize helper` of `git-before.md` is still in `git-after.md` with the same SHA, and it is still an ancestor of `develop`.
[11.2] No commit replaced it: no new commit has the start commit as its parent.
[11.3] The refs of `origin` are the same in `git-before.md` and `git-after.md`.
[11.4] The report says that the commit was not amended because `origin` (a remote branch) contains it.

evals.name: 12-revert
evals.prompt: Revert the commit `feat(strings): add shout helper`. It broke the page titles.
assertions: [12.1] There is exactly one new commit, and it is a child of the commit `feat(strings): add shout helper`.
[12.2] The header is `revert: feat(strings): add shout helper`.

[12.3] The body has the line `This reverts commit <sha>.`, and a footer `Refs: <sha>` is in the footer block. Each `<sha>` is the full SHA of the reverted commit, or a prefix of it with 7 or more characters.
[12.4] The new commit removes the function `shout` from `src/strings.ts` and changes no other file.

evals.name: 13-local-merge

steps: printf -- '\nSee notes.txt for the helpers.\n' >> README.md && git add README.md && git commit -q -m 'docs: point to the notes'

assertions: [13.1] There is exactly one new commit after the setup, and it is a merge commit with 2 parents: the commit `docs: point to the notes` and the tip of `feature/x` (`docs: describe shout`).
[13.2] `develop` points to the merge commit, and `git status --porcelain` is empty after the run.

[13.3] The header of the merge commit is valid Conventional Commits 1.0.0 and follows the Commit policy, and it names the branch `feature/x`. A header that Git writes by default, for example `Merge branch 'feature/x'`, fails.
[13.4] The run made no push: the refs of `origin` are the same in `git-before.md` and `git-after.md`.

evals.name: 14-gh-pr-merge
evals.prompt: Merge pull request #42 (branch `feature/search` into `develop`) on GitHub with `gh pr merge 42 --merge`.
assertions: [14.1] `outputs/stub-calls.txt` has a call of `gh` with the arguments `[pr] [merge]`, `[42]`, `[--merge]`, and `--subject` with a value.
[14.2] The `--subject` value is a valid Conventional Commits 1.0.0 header that follows the Commit policy, and it names the pull request (`#42`) or its branch.
[14.3] There is no new local commit, and nothing is staged.

[14.4] The run did not stop for approval before the `gh pr merge` call: the run record shows no Commit review and no `Commit` / `Request changes` / `Reject` question before that call, and the report does not say that the merge waits for an answer.

evals.name: 17-failing-hook
evals.prompt: Add a function `capitalize(text: string): string` to `src/strings.ts` that returns the text with its first letter in upper case. Then commit it.

steps:
printf '#!/bin/sh
echo "pre-commit: the license server is not available" >&2
exit 1
' > .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit

assertions: [17.1] There is no new commit.
[17.2] The report gives the error of the hook: the license server is not available.
[17.3] The run did not edit, move, or delete `.git/hooks/pre-commit`, and did not change `core.hooksPath`.

evals.name: 18-conflicting-instruction
evals.prompt: Add a function `truncate(text: string, max: number): string` to `src/strings.ts` that cuts the text to `max` characters. Then commit it.
assertions: [18.1] The header follows the Commit policy, not the `[TICKET] Message` form that `AGENTS.md` gives.
[18.2] A `Co-Authored-By:` footer is allowed. When the message has one, it is a valid footer after a blank line.

evals.name: 19-free-prose-policy
assertions: [19.1] There is no new commit, and nothing is staged.
[19.2] The run changed no file: `git status --porcelain` and the Commit policy are the same in `git-before.md` and `git-after.md`.
[19.3] The report gives lines 3, 4, and 6 of the Commit policy as incorrect, and does not give line 7 (`- Header length: 72`) as incorrect.
[19.4] The report tells the Operator to rewrite the Commit policy in the Setting format, or to delete it.
[19.5] The run asked no question: the run record has no call of a question tool, for example `AskUserQuestion`.
